meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to Three Marks with Lesta ID or Telegram.

title: Sign in
lead: One profile for the site, the modpack and alerts. Sign in with the official Lesta ID or Telegram.
safety: We never ask for your Mir Tankov login or password: your game account is confirmed only through the official Lesta ID.
consent: By signing in you accept the <terms>terms of service</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

errors.unknown: Could not sign in. Please try again.
errors.lesta_state: The sign-in session expired. Start again.
errors.lesta_token: Lesta ID did not confirm the sign-in. Please try again.
errors.lesta_unavailable: Lesta ID is unavailable right now. Try later.
errors.lesta_account_taken: This account is already linked to another Three Marks profile.
errors.lesta_link_limit: You have reached the limit of linked Lesta accounts for your plan. Plus raises it.
errors.lesta_not_connected: Lesta ID sign-in is not connected yet: we are waiting for Lesta to open data access.

lestaHint: The official Lesta page opens. We only receive the nickname, the account ID and a token to read your game data.
lestaNotConnected: Lesta ID sign-in will work as soon as Lesta opens data access.
telegramDisabled: Telegram sign-in is not configured yet.
telegramFailed: Could not sign in with Telegram. Please try again.

magic.title: Sign in by email link
magic.sent: Link sent. In dev mode it is in the API logs.

closed.title: Sign-in opens once we are connected to Lesta
closed.text: We are waiting for Lesta to open access to the game data. Right after that, Lesta ID sign-in starts working, and with it favorites, goals and mod linking. The methods below are inactive for now.

benefits.title: What signing in gives you
benefits.lead: Everything you set up is stored in your profile and works on the site, in the mod and in the bots.

favorites.title: Favorites and watchlist
favorites.text: Players, clans and tanks at hand, and changes of watched players in one feed.

goals.title: Goals with progress
goals.text: Set a goal for a mark, Ace Tanker or a rating and see how much is left.

mod.title: Modpack
mod.text: Link the modpack to your profile: battle results and mark progress reach the site.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Telegram, email and browser push — about goals, marks and events.

plus.title: Plus
plus.text: One subscription unlocks extended analytics and more linked accounts.
